outputs.prompt:
Use case: scientific-educational. Draw an attractive precise dataset-construction method figure for a CVPR paper, wide landscape approx 3.1:1, white background, vector-like fine dark-slate strokes, tasteful teal/lavender/amber header accents, legible serif scientific typography, clean geometry, efficient whitespace. Subtle small stick skeleton drawings and event cards may help, but no large characters or decorative artwork. No glossy effects, gradients, shadows, cartoon style, logos, sample counts, project paths, internal dataset names, or giant heading.
The key requirement is HONEST PROVENANCE: the CURRENT RELEASED reference labels derive from 2D rule-event logs and GPT text rewriting, while NLF/MotionScript v2 is an implemented geometric EXTENSION whose integration into those labels is NOT established. Show the first route as a clear solid-arrow upper lane, the extension as a separate dashed lower lane.
UPPER lane heading "Current reference-label route". Exactly FIVE numbered steps, left to right:
"1  Paired media" with two tiny stacked sources "Dance video" and "Aligned music".
"2  Rule-event evidence" with a simple 2D pose sketch and two short example event cards "wrist direction" and "elbow / knee angle change". A small note says "Windowed event IDs".
"3  Text refinement" with exact model name "GPT-6.1-sol" and short text "Rewrite supported movements".
"4  Attribution + checks" with short rows "Sentence ↔ event links", "Coverage / repetition flags". Do not imply checks prove correctness.
"5  Music–text sample" with a compact paper card "Choreography caption", a separate "Paired music" strip, and a small "Source + quality metadata" label.
Solid arrows connect VIDEO from Step1 to Step2, Step2 to Step3, Step3 to Step4, Step4 to Step5. A separate slender audio-retention line runs FROM "Aligned music" in Step1 to "Paired music" in Step5, bypassing Step3. Never draw music as an input to the text refiner.
LOWER lane heading "Implemented geometry extension". Connect a dashed branch from Dance video to three small modules in order:
"NLF" / "3D body geometry"
"MotionScript v2" / "Temporal events + support masks"
"Evidence-preserving consolidation" / "Traceable occurrences"
A dashed arrow from the consolidation module points upward toward the refinement interface, with exact label "integration interface". This dashed arrow must not visually turn the extension into the established production history. Add a short visible note at the end of this lower lane: "Not established as current-label provenance".
Constraints: Current production and extension must remain visually distinct with solid versus dashed styling, not just fine-print. No model besides GPT-6.1-sol for text refinement; no VLM/audio model inference in the current reference route. Do not fabricate visual-observation improvement, action-accuracy gains, or a larger measured action vocabulary. Make the diagram useful in the main paper and understandable without implementation filenames. Keep chronological order 1→2→3→4→5 unmistakable.

Redesign this evaluation figure to be much more visually sophisticated and attractive for a top-tier CVPR paper. Preserve the scientific content, all nine dimension IDs, the exact 1–5 rubric, and evidence requirements. The existing figure looks like three dense spreadsheet tables; change the visual composition substantially.
Create a premium editorial scientific infographic, wide landscape around 2.8:1, white background, carefully balanced teal, indigo/lavender and warm amber accents, fine precise strokes, generous negative space, tasteful strong typography. Use refined sans-serif body labels and elegant serif headings. Avoid heavy enclosing boxes, table grids, full-width colored banners, gradients, shadows, glossy UI, 3D, clip-art people, generic robot pictures, logos, or fake charts. Main visual interest should come from hierarchy, custom minimalist line illustrations, small colored dimension badges and purposeful arrows.
LEFT about 18% width: an elegant MUSIC WAVEFORM over a compact TIMED SCORE paper illustration with 3 short event lines. Label only "Music audio" and "Timed choreography". Two graceful arrows converge on a small outlined label "Evidence-grounded review". Add a tiny "anonymous methods" note. Do not name a particular judge model.
CENTER about 55% width: three airy rounded group cards with thin colored edges, NO horizontal table rules. Each has a small bespoke line illustration in its top margin: linked movement units for composition; abstract coordinated limb lines for local movement; pulse and articulation marks for music response. They must not be busy decorative clip-art.
TEAL card heading "Whole-song composition", with these three ID badges and concise labels spaced as separate rows:
"L1  Boundary continuity"
"L2  Global development"
"L3  Motifs + variation"
LAVENDER card heading "Local movement":
"D1  Specificity"
"D2  Body / space"
"D3  Written feasibility"
BLUE card heading "Music response":
"D4  Rhythm"
"D5  Expression"
"D6  Local development"
Use circles or small pills containing L1 etc, then plain labels. ID must appear exactly once in this central taxonomy. No colored statistical plots.
RIGHT about 22% width: visually distinctive FIVE-STEP score stair/ladder with slender ascending offset blocks, each displaying its number and a short label, very legible and with no overlap. Exact labels:
"1  Core failure"
"2  Critical defect"
"3  Usable, incomplete"
"4  Minor issues"
"5  Fully evidenced"
Small heading "Strict 1–5 rubric". No numerical results or scores assigned to methods.
BOTTOM a compact, visually elegant evidence ribbon spanning center and right. Use 3 tiny custom line symbols: quotation marks, event tag, clock/audio. Text "Action quote + event IDs + reason" and on a second line "Music-linked dimensions: audible evidence + global timestamps". Under the ribbon, two detached understated chips "Unknown: insufficient evidence" and "D6 N/A: applicability frozen first". Put "L2/L3 and D4–D6 require audio evidence" as a small caption near the taxonomy. This explicit repeated grouping note is allowed; central dimension rows still appear once each.
Make the composition feel designed, asymmetric but balanced, not like a presentation template. Readability at two-column full-page width is essential. Keep all critical English labels spelled correctly. This is a PROTOCOL schematic, not a calibrated score visualization or a performance plot. Favor concise wording and expressive visual structure over many words.
